children: Valaris announced Brazil's CADE cleared the Transocean business combination without restrictions, starting a 15-day publication waiting period.
CADE decided the merger may be put into effect without restrictions; publication expected Oct 15–16, 2026.
Publication will trigger a 15-day waiting period; once final, all regulatory approvals for closing will be satisfied.
Valaris and Transocean currently anticipate closing in Q4 2026, subject to remaining conditions and waivers.
Transaction terms: Transocean to acquire Valaris for 15.235 Transocean shares per Valaris share.
